_doc: v79.15.0 (item 1): the remedy and general-part articles the verified analysis step (src/rag/analysis_step.py, flag ANALYSIS_STEP) never accepts as a line (linea_principale / linea_subordinata): a line on one of them is rejected, the step re-asked once with the reason, then the line is «da determinare». The brief's initial content. «articles»: by compact code (cc = codice civile, cp = codice penale), each an article number («1218», «62-bis») or a range {"from", "to"} -- both ends included, a suffixed article between its number and the next (59, 60, 61, 62, 62-bis). «when_contractual»: the articles in the set only when the verified frame says the relationship is contractual (2043 c.c.: the extracontractual remedy beside a contract claim) -- «contractual» defines it from the verified frame's fields: a frame whose rito is not penal and whose addebito_o_domanda article is a c.c. article inside «cc_ranges» (Libro IV, Titoli I-III: obligations in general, contracts in general, the single contracts -- 1173 to 2042) or whose addebito_o_domanda (descrizione, frase) or istituto (testo) holds a word beginning with one of «stems». The frame's own verified addebito/domanda article is never rejected as a remedy (it is the charge or the claim the line must carry).
